explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/59: is the number of labelled H-free graphs on n vertices ≤ 2^{(1+o(1)) ex(n;H)}? The answer is no (Morris–Saxton, H = C₆). The statement negates the claim for all H containing a cycle. That restriction is justified: for forests the claim fails trivially (e.g. P₃-free graphs include all matchings), so the cycle restriction matches the meaningful reading in [MoSa16]. Faithful.
